_comment: Sanjauli ka structured naksha. Har sadak ka tukda naam ke saath hai aur uspe dukanon ke slot pehle se gine hue hain, taaki baad mein asli dukan apni asli jagah par lag sake: shops.json mein 'slot' likh do. Coordinates abhi approx hain -- OSM is container se block hai (403). tools/shimla_pipeline --preset sanjauli chalane par asli geometry aayegi.
$width_comment: Chaudai `data/roads.json` ke road_types se **milti hui** honi chahiye. Round 18 mein sadak chaudi ki gayi thi par ye file chhoot gayi -- nateeja: dukaanein, bazaar ke rahgeer aur bus sab purani (sankri) chaudai ke hisaab se lagte rahe aur nayi chaudi sadak unke upar aa gayi. Dono jagah ek saath badalni hai.
